messages:
alex: FYI — Acme procurement flagged two charges for the same subscription. Customer attached PO PO-9876 and needs this cleaned up today.
alex: Charges: inv_2026_1001 and inv_2026_1002. Both posted for $5,000 + 20% VAT on Feb 1 and Feb 2.
maria: Opening CS ticket and pulling gateway logs now. Are these two separate captures or a duplicate capture event?
billing-bot: Alert: gateway response 'duplicate_capture' for txn_abc123 at 2026-02-02T03:45:12Z — possible webhook retry.
jordan: Looks like our webhook ack timed out -> retry path created a new invoice instead of skipping. The retry flow doesn't check existing pending invoice for sub_742.
megan: Customer asks: will refund create a negative invoice or a credit note? They need a clean PO reconciliation record.
maria: We'll issue a full refund on inv_2026_1002, then generate a credit_note referencing inv_2026_1001 -> will include VAT reversal lines so their AP team can reconcile.
alex: Please use the original PO reference on the credit note (PO-9876) so their automated system picks it up.
jordan: Technical action: I'll add idempotency key check before invoice creation and short circuit if an invoice already exists in status {pending, processing} for the same subscription and billing cycle.
megan: Can finance confirm VAT handling? If we refund gross and emit a credit note, will that satisfy EU VAT reversal for their accounting?
maria: Finance pinged — confirmation: issue full refund + credit_note with VAT reversal lines. They will update journal entries; expect 24-48h for their reconciliation.
megan: Refund action started: refund_7890 created against inv_2026_1002 (full amount). Using idempotency token `refund_inv_2026_1002_v1`.
billing-bot: Refund completed: refund_7890 at 2026-02-02T04:02:31Z. Gateway settlement pending.
alex: Sent customer confirmation email with refund + credit note attachments and PO ref. They replied: "Thanks, refund shows pending in our bank portal — will confirm once posted." :thumbsup:
jordan: Created INF-2125 to prevent duplicate invoice creation; PR will include unit + integration tests for webhook retry path.
maria: Marking CS ticket CS-5234 with resolution "accidental renewal due to webhook retry" and linking INF-2125 and accounting ticket ACCT-998.
megan: Noting for next ops retro: add monitoring for duplicate invoice spikes and a dashboard alert.
alex: Customer just confirmed funds posted. Closing loop — thanks everyone.
